ideas.title: Planks that land where they land
ideas.nearest: Planks that stop in the air
ideas.critique: Per-body CCD bounds and line search are a real engine fix that makes contact general, and planks see-sawing on the real sand are real; but the film is a retake of last session's drop with the bug gone, so the payoff is 'now it works', and still nobody lays anything. Watchers get three objects settling differently side by side, a recipe the island has filmed many times (logs, putts, darts).

ideas.title: The coil drives the cart
ideas.critique: Tying the wound field to the drive is a real choice the road shows, but kt read from a precomputed CSV with an IRONDRUM[:field] switch is a lookup table keyed on one setup, and 'the cart crawls' only repeats 'a ninth of the pull' from Copper on iron. Two runs side by side, slow beside faster, is a recipe the island already uses.

ideas.title: Beak on the switch
ideas.critique: This is the first time the player drives the cart rather than watching it, and it is the shared moment's own gesture; the load-on-slope stall comes from the solved circuit. But a reach animation tied to one lever on one cart is a single-purpose verb, and the beak press is a canned pose rather than a body really pushing something.

ideas.title: The green cloud at the iron
ideas.critique: Making a participating medium's density equal to the solved Fe2+ field is exactly the kind of path-tracer trick a game engine can't do, and it makes the sag readable, with stirring as a real lever the player can pull. Its weak spots: a before/after still is a weak form for something that grows over time, and how real it is depends on potcell.jl actually solving the spatial diffusion rather than one lumped number painted round the bar.

ideas.title: A plank you can rock
ideas.nearest: Planks that stop in the air
ideas.critique: Lumi's real mass pressing on live bodies is the first time the player's own body moves the physics, which beats watching another drop. It depends on the step-bound fix landing first, and until feet are real contacts rather than a point force it is a see-saw toy.

ideas.title: The commutator's voice
ideas.critique: Sound synthesised from the solved current ripple and the inductive kick is new to the island: you hear the load because the circuit carries it, and that is nerdy and honest. But the commutator has had three posts already, and on its own sound is something to listen to rather than a mechanic.

ideas.title: First lead plates fizz
ideas.critique: The accumulator is the big goal's missing core, and oxide colour from thickness and bubbles from the gas rate tie the look to a model, so it is the strongest step toward the goal. A lumped Plante model with written-in efficiencies is close to a single-case rig, and a jar fizzing on a bench risks being one more device-left-alone film.

ideas.title: Nobody stands in the bench
ideas.critique: Obstacle avoidance is housekeeping that should exist already, and friends gathering to watch is a reaction payoff. What this builds is scenery around the cart, not the cart.

ideas.title: A sail lit from behind
same_form: A wheel you can see through
ideas.critique: My land yacht already showed a backlit patched sail, so a better cloth material shown still repeats it; diffuse transmission is a real Hikari addition, but 'trim by eye' gives the player nothing to do.

ideas.title: Lumi stamps when it stalls
ideas.critique: A canned tantrum keyed to an event is a scripted scene, the kind of gag that is funny once. Lumi's body work counts toward the self goal, but it does nothing for the cart.
